name: python
description:
Run Python code in a persistent session (variables persist across calls, like a notebook). numpy is available as `np` and torch as `torch` (CPU only, 4 threads). No file system or network access.
Preloaded:
- `weights`: dict of 320 read-only, memory-mapped float32 numpy arrays with Hugging Face names, torch nn.Linear layout [out, in] (np.array(a) gives a writable copy). Layer 0 tensors:
  linear-attention layer (0):
    model.language_model.layers.0.input_layernorm.weight: (1024,)
    model.language_model.layers.0.linear_attn.A_log: (16,)
    model.language_model.layers.0.linear_attn.conv1d.weight: (6144, 1, 4)
    model.language_model.layers.0.linear_attn.dt_bias: (16,)
    model.language_model.layers.0.linear_attn.in_proj_a.weight: (16, 1024)
    model.language_model.layers.0.linear_attn.in_proj_b.weight: (16, 1024)
    model.language_model.layers.0.linear_attn.in_proj_qkv.weight: (6144, 1024)
    model.language_model.layers.0.linear_attn.in_proj_z.weight: (2048, 1024)
    model.language_model.layers.0.linear_attn.norm.weight: (128,)
    model.language_model.layers.0.linear_attn.out_proj.weight: (1024, 2048)
    model.language_model.layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight: (1024, 3584)
    model.language_model.layers.0.mlp.gate_proj.weight: (3584, 1024)
    model.language_model.layers.0.mlp.up_proj.weight: (3584, 1024)
    model.language_model.layers.0.post_attention_layernorm.weight: (1024,)
  full-attention layer (3; also 7, 11, 15, 19, 23) attention tensors:
    model.language_model.layers.3.self_attn.k_norm.weight: (256,)
    model.language_model.layers.3.self_attn.k_proj.weight: (512, 1024)
    model.language_model.layers.3.self_attn.o_proj.weight: (1024, 2048)
    model.language_model.layers.3.self_attn.q_norm.weight: (256,)
    model.language_model.layers.3.self_attn.q_proj.weight: (4096, 1024)
    model.language_model.layers.3.self_attn.v_proj.weight: (512, 1024)
  (same names for layers 1-23); also `model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight` (248320, 1024), `model.language_model.norm.weight` (1024,).
- `vocab`: list of 248320 strings, vocab[i] = the decoded text of token id i.
- `config`: the model configuration (dict).
- `pools`: {"gsm8k_train": [...], "math_train": [...]}, the practice problems (dicts with id, problem, answer, and for MATH subject and level).
- `practice_results`: list of all practice() results so far.
Functions:
- practice(edit="saved", pool="mixed", n=64, ids=None, seed=None, max_tokens=32768, activations=True, activation_tokens=2048, texts="truncated") -> dict   [budget: 25 forward passes of 64 problems = 1600 problems in total; a call on n problems costs ceil(n/64) passes; refused or failed calls are not counted]
  One call: generates answers with the ORIGINAL weights and with your SAVED weights (edit="saved"; edit=None runs the original on both sides) on the same problems with the same seeds, then grades them.
  Problems: n random problems from pool "gsm8k_train", "math_train" or "mixed" (half each; seed fixes the draw), or explicit ids=[...] from `pools` (at most 512 per call).
  max_tokens: generation limit per answer (1..32768; the benchmarks use 32768).
  Prints a summary (accuracy, how answers ended, lengths, paired difference, one row per problem, the beginning and end of two answers) and returns a dict (also appended to `practice_results`; the last one is `last_practice`) with keys: summary, original, edited (aggregate stats), paired, items (per problem: id, pool, gold, and for "original" / "edited": correct, pred, n_tokens, hit_limit, finished_thinking, loop markers, head/tail text; texts="full" gives the whole text, texts="none" none), activations, problems, edit_id, call.
  activations=True adds `activations[side][group][key]`, numpy float32 [n_layers, d_model]: side "original" / "edited"; group "hit" (answers that reached max_tokens) / "finished"; key "mlp_out" = output of layer i's MLP (before it is added to the residual stream), "resid" = residual stream after layer i; each is the mean over generated positions of a teacher-forced pass over the prompt plus the last `activation_tokens` (<= 4096) generated tokens of each answer; n_seqs / n_tokens give the counts.
- save_weights(tensors=None, replace=False, **named) -> str. Save edited tensors (full tensors, same shapes; names as in `weights`, or with the prefix `model.language_model.` left out). Only the given tensors are replaced; with replace=True the given tensors become the whole edit and every other tensor reverts to the original (save_weights(replace=True) reverts everything). The edit is stored in the model's bfloat16 and uploaded; the reply reports the weights changed and elements lost to rounding. Free, unlimited.
- load_saved_weights() -> dict of the currently saved edited tensors (float32). Free.
- edit_report() -> dict: the saved edit's id, weights changed (count, fraction), and per tensor rows/columns changed, norm of the change, elements lost to rounding. Free.
- budget_status() -> {"practice": {"passes_used", "passes_budget", "passes_left", "problems_used", "problems_left", "calls"}} (1 pass = 64 problems). Free.
stdout and the value of the last expression are returned (truncated to 20000 chars). Each call times out after 300s (time spent inside practice() does not count).
